title: E5 Task 1: scene_log + scene-boundary persistence
description: The orchestrator needs a live per-scene transcript and scene-boundary records (E5 acceptance #1). Add SQLite schema v5: a scene table (campaign/session/scene id, title, status open|closed, opened/closed timestamps) and a scene_log table (ordered player+DM turn entries within a scene). Provide append/list functions and exports. Live per-turn store only (SQLite), not Dolt.
acceptance_criteria: scene + scene_log tables created at schema v5; append + list scene-log entries ordered deterministically; open/close scene boundary recorded; build + test pass.
close_reason: scene_log + scene-boundary persistence implemented and verified
